timing: Whole-image direction resolved from the new envelope, controls and independent random draw before neutral category selection and baseline drafting
whole_image_direction: An indoor working portrait makes the passing shuttle, slack edge loop and growing woven band tell one small manufacturing moment. Warm autumn clothes carry distinct structures around the same moving hands; quiet concentration and daylight make the fictional person's presence specific without inventing reference biography.
alternative_review: A frontal display holding a finished scarf would show clothing but remove the material process and current difficulty. An overhead loom close-up would explain the threads while losing the face and garment hierarchy. A seated oblique portrait with the loom offset beside her keeps the face, two hand targets, partially built cloth and autumn layers readable together. This remains a restrained variation under saved creativity=1, with subtle human attraction, fetish=0 and surreal=0.
